messages:
maya: Heads up — a few inbound leads from HubSpot are getting stuck on claim routing. Looks like the sticky-owner gating we flipped on Friday is preventing RR (round-robin) from cycling when enrichment is slow. Observed ~23 leads in the last 2h.

sam: ugh. can you paste an example lead id?

maya:  LH-89234 and LH-89240. stack: hs webhook -> enrichment service -> claim-router -> SF upsert. enrichment latency is spiking to 90s so gating stays true and owner never releases.

liu: nice catch. is the sticky gating boolean a per-connector flag or global?

maya: per-connector. we enabled it on hubspot-prod to reduce churn during partial enrichments, but didn't add a TTL fallback.

jennifer: quick mitigation: revert hubspot-prod to sticky=false and run a targeted backfill to requeue those lead ids for normal RR. can ops do the revert + backfill? @aaron

aaron: I can flip the flag in 5m. for backfill I can run a script that re-enqueues claim attempts with exponential jitter. sample command:
```bash
./scripts/requeue_claims --source=hubspot-prod --ids=LH-89234,LH-89240 --mode=rr --dry-run=false
```

maya: thanks. also want to avoid this recurring — proposal: add a gating TTL (e.g., 30s) and a debounced enrichment health-check that overrides gating after 3 failed enrichment attempts.

sam: agree. product/marketing note: sticky-owner helped demo flows but we don’t want it harming SLAs. we should document default TTL and warn on enable.

liu: engineer-side: implement gating_ttl and a metric: gating_duration_seconds with tags {connector, org}. put an alert if pct>0.5 for 5m.

jennifer: ops + eng plan:
- aaron to flip sticky=false now (in ~5m)
- aaron to run requeue script for affected ids
- liu to add gating_ttl + metric PR by EOD
- sam to update runbook and marketing handoff doc with warning blurb
- maya to monitor leads_reassigned and claim_latency dashboards for 2h after rollback

ops-bot: scheduled change: toggle-connector-flag(hubspot-prod, sticky_owner=false) queued by aaron. ETA 5 minutes.

aaron: toggle done. requeue started (no dry-run). progress: 2/2 ids re-enqueued.

maya: seeing those leads go through RR again, nice. I'll keep an eye for any duplicates in SF.

sam: can we also add a canary in the enrichment pipeline that reduces concurrency for new sticky toggles until we see stable latency?

liu: yes — I'll include a canary flag for gating_ttl PR. default off, enable for hubspot-prod after metrics look stable.

jennifer: sounds good. next steps recorded. thanks team :thumbsup:

maya: thanks all — will post a short incident summary once we hit 2h monitor window.
